hero.title: Packaging materials for food and industry, delivered across Europe and beyond.
hero.text: Aluminium liners, food-grade and kraft papers, polypropylene film, technical rolls and adhesives — sourced from proven manufacturers and supplied in the formats you need.

about.title: A reliable partner for packaging supplies
paragraphs: Tagalika supplies packaging materials to food producers and industrial manufacturers across the European Union and beyond. We work with proven European mills and converters and deliver aluminium liners, food-grade and kraft papers, decorative wrapping papers, polypropylene film, technical rolls and packaging adhesives.
We supply materials in the formats, widths and quantities our customers need, with clear specifications, reliable lead times and direct, personal service — from the first inquiry to delivery.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This website is a business card of {{legalName}}. It has no contact forms, uses no cookies and runs no analytics or advertising tools.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is {{legalName}} (company details are given at the bottom of this page). For any privacy matters, write to {{email}}.

sections.title: What data we process and why
paragraphs: If you write to us by e-mail, we process the data you give us — usually your name, company, contact details and the content of your message — to reply to you, prepare an offer and carry out an order (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), and for our legitimate interest in conducting business correspondence (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: Website hosting
paragraphs: The website is hosted by Cloudflare, Inc. When you open the site, Cloudflare processes technical data such as your IP address in server logs to deliver the pages and protect them against abuse. The site loads no external fonts, scripts or trackers.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: We keep correspondence for as long as needed to handle your inquiry and our business relationship, and afterwards for as long as required by law (for example tax and accounting rules) or to establish and defend claims.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your data, have it corrected or erased, restrict its processing, object to processing and receive your data in a portable format. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority: in Latvia this is the Data State Inspectorate (Datu valsts inspekcija), or the authority in your own EU country.
